# UX Hub (UX Hub Global)

> UX Hub is a premier Digital Business Growth Consultancy & Enterprise Software Solutions provider operating across India, Saudi Arabia (KSA), the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the broader GCC region. UX Hub specializes in real-time competitor pricing intelligence, automated dynamic repricing, e-commerce growth acceleration, 0→1 digital product development, and venture scaling.

## Core Software Solutions & Products

- [UX Hub Pricing Super Intelligence (Product)](https://uxhubglobal.com/product.html): Real-time omnichannel competitor price intelligence, automated SKU matching, price drop detection, MAP compliance monitoring, and dynamic repricing for e-commerce brands and retailers across Amazon, Noon, Trendyol, Jarir, Centrepoint, and online storefronts.
- [14-Day Free Trial Registration](https://uxhubglobal.com/registration.html): Instant access to competitor price tracking for up to 50,000+ SKUs with automated alerts.

## Consultancy Services & Practices

- [Services Overview](https://uxhubglobal.com/services.html): End-to-end digital growth services:
  - Product Growth & 0→1 Strategy
  - E-commerce Scaling, Channel Optimization & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  - Digital Experience Architecture (Web & Mobile Platforms)
  - Go-To-Market (GTM) & Regional Expansion (India ↔ KSA Corridor)
  - Digital Transformation & Enterprise Tech Modernization

## Regional Focus & Markets Served

- **India**: Tech innovation, digital product engineering, and digital growth consultancy.
- **Saudi Arabia (KSA) & GCC**: Market expansion, cross-border e-commerce, regional price intelligence in SAR / AED / KWD / QAR / BHD / OMR currencies, and marketplace seller enablement across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dubai, and the Arabian Gulf.
